name: Should I try to clean smoke-damaged furniture myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I try to clean smoke-damaged furniture myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor smoke odors might be temporarily reduced with home remedies, professional intervention is generally recommended for effective and lasting smoke odor removal from furniture. DIY methods often only mask the smell rather than neutralizing the embedded smoke particles. Improper cleaning can also inadvertently set the odor, cause further damage to fabrics or finishes, or spread soot. Professionals have the expertise, specialized equipment, and appropriate cleaning agents to safely and thoroughly address smoke damage without causing additional harm, ensuring a more complete and long-term solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: For effective and lasting results, professional smoke odor removal is recommended. DIY methods can often only mask the smell or cause further damage.
